```{r}
#| include: false
knitr::opts_chunk$set(dev.args = list(bg = "#fdf6e3"))

source <- function(file, ...) {
  base::source(file, ...)
  if (basename(file) == "setup.R") {
    solarized <- function(...) {
      ggthemes::theme_solarized(base_size = 11, base_family = plot_font) +
        ggplot2::theme(panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
                       legend.position  = "bottom",
                       plot.margin      = ggplot2::margin(5, 5, 5, 5))
    }
    theme_bw      <<- solarized
    theme_minimal <<- solarized
  }
}
```
